protocol.description: Minimal staging protocol for tagging wl_surface buffer color encoding. Full color management should eventually use wp_color_management_v1.

interface.name: focaldesk_color_manager_v1
interface.description: Singleton for attaching color tags to wl_surface objects.

entry.name: surface_exists
entry.summary: a color tag object already exists for the surface

request.name: get_surface

description.summary: create a color tag for a wl_surface

request.description: If a focaldesk_surface_color_v1 object already exists for the given wl_surface, the surface_exists protocol error is raised.

interface.name: focaldesk_surface_color_v1
interface.description: Tag state is double-buffered and takes effect on the next wl_surface.commit.

request.name: set_transfer
request.description: If this object is inert, the inert protocol error is raised.

request.name: unset
request.description: After commit the surface reverts to the compositor default (sRGB).
